name: Indexed Finance DEFI5 reindex value extrapolation

classification.summary: The DEFI5 index pool's extrapolatePoolValueFromToken() estimated total pool value from the balance/denorm of a single initialized token, so flash-loaned deposits that skewed that token set an absurd minimum balance for the freshly reindexed SUSHI record and let the attacker mint index tokens against the pool's real assets.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

sources.note: onchain review: the cited tx's logs touch DEFI5 0xfa6de269 (not CC10); pool created 2020-12-06 by 0x236eccab8cdcfedb099de85c4060024ba3ce4d46, not by attack sender 0xba5ed148; classified code-bug because the manipulated quantity is the pool's own internal value extrapolation, not an external price feed

re-check 2026 (deployment-basis rows with a DELEGATECALL in the runtime): CORRECTION. The pool is a DelegateCallProxyManyToOne: its runtime hardcodes the implementation holder 0xffde4785e980a99fe10e6a87a67d243664b91b25 as an immutable and STATICCALLs it for the delegate target, so no EIP-1967 event is ever emitted and the deployment basis was wrong. Binary-searching eth_getStorageAt on slot 0 of that holder over [11398665, 13417949] shows the implementation moved twice after the pool was deployed: 0x71ed5fa0fde7b6dd8bc0dc25f7235d477e0faf77 -> 0x2483c55e414447cc78b0bfac77c1471d81baabdf at block 11800940 (2021-02-06T05:43:57Z) and -> 0x5bd628141c62a901e0a83e630ce5fafa95bbdee4 at block 12347624 (2021-05-01T10:07:22Z), then constant to the incident (61-point dense re-probe over [12347624, 13417949]). Corroborated by the proxy manager 0xd23dedc599bd56767e42d48484d6ca96ab01c115's own ManyToOne_ImplementationUpdated(bytes32,address) events for implementation id 0xe4105e36f4402bad908f77146a54b96b1aae362be2a9d940c0e19537431e1efb at exactly those two blocks, and by callTracer on the exploit tx, which shows the pool delegatecalling only 0x5bd628141c62a901e0a83e630ce5fafa95bbdee4 (a leaf: zero DELEGATECALL opcodes). Age 1634236663 - 1619863642 = 14,373,021 s (166.4 d), was 26,985,350 s (312.3 d) from deployment.
